def legendre_sequence(p):
    """Generate Legendre sequence of length p"""
    seq = []
    for i in range(p):
        if i == 0:
            seq.append(1)  # or -1, convention varies
        else:
            # Compute Legendre symbol (i/p)
            ls = pow(i, (p-1)//2, p)
            if ls == 0:
                seq.append(0)
            elif ls == 1:
                seq.append(1)
            else:
                seq.append(-1)
    return seq
